title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person TOCTOU backstop unwired + race pin vacuous — the executed awaiting UPDATE still has no taken_over_at guard
evidence:
form_handler.gleam:1249-1258: `False ->
              case
                sql.update_reference_call_status(
                  config.db,
                  id_uuid,
                  sql.AwaitingCorrection,
                  "",
                  "contact_invalid",
                  sql.ContactInitiated,
                )` — update_reference_call_status.sql WHERE is `WHERE id = $1
  AND status = $5::reference_call_status` (no taken_over_at clause). mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql (`AND taken_over_at IS NULL`) is called ONLY by the test (grep: sql.gleam wrapper + test lines 1746/1758), never by production code. Test: `let assert Ok(returned) =
    rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)
  list.length(returned.rows) |> should.equal(0)`
detail: Handler still executes the unguarded status-only UPDATE for the wrong-person awaiting transition; the guarded SQL has zero production callers and the test calls it directly, so an unwired backstop stays green. Both round-4 conditions unmet — take-over racing the POST still yanks the row.
recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person; rewrite the race test to drive POST /reference/:token/wrong-person with a take-over between token read and UPDATE, and neutralize the SQL backstop to prove it bites.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): co_nudge_bounce_stands_down_test is a vacuous pin — the fixture timestamp, not the kind-exclusion, stands the bounce down
evidence: `attempts = '[{"at":"2026-08-01T08:00:00Z","channel":"email","outcome":"delivered","detail":"ref_send_1"},{"at":"2026-08-01T09:00:00Z","channel":"email","outcome":"delivered","detail":"co_nudge_send_1","kind":"co_nudge"}]'::jsonb` then do_correct (corrected_at=now()); the co-nudge entry's fixed 2026-08-01T09:00:00Z predates corrected_at, so send_is_post_correction=false and the webhook's `case row.matched_send_at == "" || row.send_is_post_correction` stands down WITHOUT the `NOT (e ? 'kind')` exclusion. Sibling tests use now()-relative fixtures (lines 958/1043/1880).
detail: The exclusion is wired in find_reference_call_by_send_ref.sql (verified), but this test would stay green if it regressed: the typed stale gate alone produces the asserted stand-down. Real co-nudges post-date the correction (T+24h sweep step), so only the exclusion protects the row.
recommended_fix: Timestamp the co-nudge entry after the correction (to_char(now() + interval '30 seconds', ...) like the genuine-failure fixture) so send_is_post_correction=true and the kind-exclusion is the deciding factor; control already exists.

title: r3 W4 pin covers only sweep_terminal — sweep_mark_failed's taken-over guard is unpinned
evidence:
Test body calls only `rc_sql.sweep_terminal(
      db,
      call,
      rc_sql.Unreachable,` — grep confirms sweep_mark_failed appears in no test file; sweep_mark_failed.sql carries the guard (`AND taken_over_at IS NULL`, line 58) and is a live path (server/src/reference_checks/sweep.gleam:655 `let _ = sql.sweep_mark_failed(db, row_uuid, reason)`).
detail: The r3 W4 finding named both terminal writers; the guard is present in both SQL files (verified) but the regression pin covers only sweep_terminal. A future guard drop on sweep_mark_failed would go unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Extend sweep_terminal_writers_respect_taken_over_test (or add a sibling) asserting rc_sql.sweep_mark_failed 0-rows on a taken-over row.

title: r3 N14sql malformed-'at' stand-down is untested — the regex-guarded cast has no pin
evidence: Guard: `CASE WHEN e->>'at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[T ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}' THEN (e->>'at')::timestamptz >= rc.corrected_at ELSE false END`; grep of the integration suite found no malformed-'at' fixture — every attempts entry is well-formed, so the ELSE-false stand-down path is never exercised.
detail: The N14sql fix is in place (verified), but the delivery-failure find's malformed-timestamp branch has zero coverage; a future cast regression would raise and drop the whole webhook event undetected by this suite.
recommended_fix: Add an integration case feeding a malformed 'at' entry (e.g. "not-a-date") and assert the delivery failure stands down (no audit, no stamp) instead of erroring.

title: Detail payload negative control weakened to an inert sentinel — form_token containment is effectively unpinned
evidence: `string.contains(body, "form_token_internal_sentinel") |> should.be_false` (replacing the prior `string.contains(body, "larry@example.com") |> should.be_false`). No code path can emit the literal sentinel, so if the detail read ever started selecting form_token the assertion still passes; list_reference_calls_for_detail.sql's containment is load-bearing but no longer verified by a real value.
detail: The old control checked a real sensitive value; the replacement asserts a string that cannot occur. The §4.2 containment claim (form_token never rides the detail payload) now rests on code reading alone.
recommended_fix: Assert a value the detail read actually could leak, e.g. fetch a row with a known form_token and assert the token string (or "form_token") is absent from the detail payload.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: Traceability at df0ea22: take-over (5 integration tests incl. 409 guards, hooks matrix 13-status, sweep exclusion, §8.6 late completion), correct (one-cycle, 400s, cross-app 404), exhaustion (SQL + webhook + wrong-person route, audit+notification), substitute (idempotence, history 409, identical-trio 400, fraud stamp), per-slot start (400/re-arm/declined), authz negatives, sweep + resend effective-contact units. r3 pins N4/N11/N15/N18/N8-client/N12 fixed; W2 pin bites; W3 pin vacuous; W4 half-pinned.
detail: P1 coverage is strong (≈90%+), but P0 is incomplete: the wrong-person race pin is vacuous and the executed UPDATE carries no backstop (separate blocker). Per round-4 rules a vacuous race pin is P0 territory — gate cannot be PASS.
